clips.title: The story
paras: Abercrombie, the peculiar hermit dwelling in western Duskwood, asks travelers to venture into the ogre stronghold of Vul'Gol Ogre Mound. He claims that ogres ambushed him while he was foraging and made off with a crate filled with his irreplaceable herbs and tools.

Isolated out along the damp roads of western Duskwood, the aged hermit Abercrombie claims he was attacked while gathering supplies in the wilderness. According to him, brutes from the southern ogre mound drove him off, forcing him to abandon a sturdy wooden crate packed with precious herbs and delicate instruments.

The Vul'Gol Ogre Mound in southern Duskwood is a fortified hive of hostile ogres who harass unwary wanderers. The crate sits right near the entrance of their cavernous mound, daring outsiders to step past roaring brutes and spell-weaving magi to haul it back to the hermit.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me! I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.
After they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood. I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.
Please, friend, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have my crate? If so, then please...give it to me quickly!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, friend! You have more than earned your reward.
